$14\sqrt{3}\,(\mathrm{c}m^{2})$$\mathrm{\overline{AD}}=\overline{DE}=4\left( cm\right) ,\,\overline{BC}=\overline{CE}=3\left( cm\right)$이므로 $\mathrm{\overline{CD}}=7\left( cm\right)$점 $\mathrm{C}$에서 $\mathrm{\overline{AD}}$에 내린 수선의 발을 $\mathrm{H}$라 하면 $\mathrm{\overline{DH}}=1\left( cm\right)$직각삼각형 $\mathrm{CDH}$에서 $\mathrm{\overline{CH}}=\sqrt{7^{2}-1^{2}}=4\sqrt{3}\left( cm\right)$사각형 $\mathrm{ABCD}$의 넓이는$\frac{\mathrm{1}}{2}\times \left( 4+3\right) \times 4\sqrt{3}=14\sqrt{3}\left( cm^{2}\right)$

$24\,(\mathrm{c}m)$$\mathrm{\overline{BE}}=\overline{BD}=4\left( cm\right) ,\,\,\,\,\overline{CE}=\overline{CF}=6\left( cm\right)$$\overline{\mathrm{AD}\mathit{}=\overline{\mathrm{AF}\mathit{}=x\left( \mathrm{c}m\right) }}$라 하면 $\overline{\mathrm{AB}\mathit{}=x+4\left( \mathrm{cm}\right) }$, $\overline{\mathrm{AC}\mathit{}=x+6\left( \mathrm{c}m\right) }$이므로직각삼각형 $\mathrm{ABC}$에서$\left( x+4\right) ^{2}+\left( x+6\right) ^{2}=10^{2}$$x^{2}+10x-24=0$, $\left( x+12\right) \left( x-2\right) =0$$x=2\,\left( x>0\right)$직각삼각형 $\mathrm{ABC}$둘레의 길이는$6+10+8=24\left( \mathrm{c}m\right)$
